title: Bitwarden Business or Keeper: Password Management for Teams
excerpt: Two business password managers compared on price per user, transparency of the code and the depth of admin reporting and control.
verdict: Bitwarden Business offers excellent value and transparency for small and mid-sized teams, with open-source code and published audits. Keeper suits larger organisations that want deeper admin reporting and control and have the budget for it.

spec1.label: Cost for teams
spec1.device1Value: Among the cheapest business plans available
spec1.device2Value: More expensive, with extra enterprise features

spec3.label: Enterprise reporting and monitoring
spec3.device2Value: Deeper reporting and control for large organisations
